title: Existence of signed Hom-complex chain shift presentations
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pod-reindexing-shift-chain-part, there exist ChainShift structures on X and Y. No compatibility with the comparison c is asserted.

source.place: Step 4, construction of the signed Hom-complex shifts before the reindexing square

proof.text: Specialize the independent-universe normalized source and target shift existence theorems to the pro-etale coefficient ring on a single scheme W. Use the identity representative isomorphism Q(P) ≅ Q(P) in LeftNormalization and RightNormalization to obtain the actual chain isomorphisms eL and eR with their fixed product projection formulas. No new chain construction or unproved intermediate theorem is needed.

For integers a,b compose the inverse source reindexing eL(P,I[b],a) with the (-a)-shift of the inverse target reindexing eR(P,I,b), then the canonical shift addition isomorphism from H(P,I)[b][-a] to H(P,I)[b-a]. To check ChainShift.formula, cancel the degree components of eL.hom and eR.hom. Their projection formulas cancel the two copies of (-1)^(a*r). The remaining equality is transport of a Hom-product projection along the integer equalities (r-a)+b = r+(b-a), (p-a)+a = p and ((p-a)+r)+b = p+(r+(b-a)); prove this transport by eliminating the equalities. The formula applies to all integers, including zero and negative shifts, without a boundedness assumption.
Apply the single-scheme construction separately to X and Y, and pair the two ChainShift witnesses. The stated conclusion asserts no compatibility with c.

proof_origin.place: Step 4; the signed Hom-complex shift construction, obtained by composing the library normalized single-variable shifts (Stacks 0A8X, 08JA).

lean.statement:
theorem chain_shift_presentations {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) :
    ∃ (sX : ChainShift l E X s) (sY : ChainShift l E Y s), True
